questions.text: The course objectives and expectations were communicated clearly.
The syllabus was well-structured and appropriately paced.
Course materials and readings were relevant and useful.
The teacher explained concepts clearly and effectively.
Classes encouraged critical and independent thinking.
Examples and illustrations made the material easier to understand.
The teacher encouraged questions and open discussion.
The teacher was approachable and responsive to students.
The teacher treated all students with respect and fairness.
Grading criteria were clear, fair, and transparent.
Feedback on assignments and exams was timely and constructive.
The teacher was punctual and regular with classes.
The teacher maintained professional integrity and conduct.
I would recommend this teacher to other students.
Overall, I am satisfied with the teaching in this course.
